description: Stage 1 ingest envelope. Every threshold here is advisory: a recording outside the envelope is flagged, never rejected. Only structural facts (no video stream, no timebase, no packets) are hard failures.
notes: The resolution and frame-rate thresholds state what this MVP claims to support, taken verbatim from the frozen operating envelope in docs/mvp-contract.md Section 1. They are deliberately NOT an answer to the separate, unmeasured question of what resolution and sampling rate a later stage needs to resolve a hand on a hold at gym-typical camera distance. If that downstream-detectability floor is ever established, it belongs here as its own threshold with its own evidence and its own status tag, not as a reinterpretation of these two.

status_tag_meaning.[FIXED]: fixed now; changing it requires a documented decision record
status_tag_meaning.[PILOT]: to be estimated from pilot footage; the current number is a placeholder, not a result
status_tag_meaning.[PLANNING]: illustrative planning guidance; not a result and not a commitment

min_width.selection: Not measured. Taken verbatim from the frozen Stage 0 operating envelope in docs/mvp-contract.md Section 1, which fixes the supported resolution at at least 1080p. Changing it requires changing that contract, not this file.

min_height.selection: Not measured. Taken verbatim from the frozen Stage 0 operating envelope in docs/mvp-contract.md Section 1 (at least 1080p). Paired with min_width so a 1080p recording in either orientation is judged against the same envelope.

min_frame_rate.selection: Not measured. Taken verbatim from the frozen Stage 0 operating envelope in docs/mvp-contract.md Section 1 (at least 30 fps). Stored as an exact rational because 30000/1001 and 810/59 both occur and neither is representable as a float without changing the recorded value.

max_distinct_pts_delta_count.selection: Definitional, not empirical. A constant-frame-rate stream has exactly one distinct inter-PTS delta; two or more distinct deltas is variable frame rate by definition. Set to 1 so the flag is a measurement of the container, not a tolerance to be tuned. Frame-drop tolerance, if it is ever wanted, belongs in a separate threshold with its own evidence.
